earnings.title: Starbucks Reports Q4 and Full Fiscal Year 2026 Results
highlights: Q4 GAAP EPS $0.59, Up 392% ; Non-GAAP EPS $0.80, Up 54%
Global Q4 Comparable Coffeehouse Sales Up 7.2%
Q4 Consolidated Net Revenues Down 4% to $9.1 billion, Reflecting the Starbucks China Transaction
Q4 GAAP Operating Margin 10.8%, Up 790 Basis Points; Non-GAAP Operating Margin 14.0%, Up 450 Basis Points
Global comparable coffeehouse sales increased 7.2%, primarily driven by a 5.2% increase in average ticket and a 1.8% increase in comparable transactions

quotes.text: We had a terrific quarter and a great year driven by our focus on the fundamentals and what has always set Starbucks apart: exceptional coffee, a moment of connection and a world-class customer experience. This gives me confidence our performance is durable.
quotes.by: Brian Niccol, chairman and chief executive officer

quotes.text: In fiscal 2026, we returned to comp growth, expanded margin and delivered stronger earnings, and we intend to build on that progress in fiscal 2027.

items.heading: Our success depends substantially on the value of our brand, and failure to preserve its value could have a negative impact on our financial results.
items.group: Risks Related to Brand Relevance and Brand Execution

items.heading: We may not be successful in our brand, marketing, promotional, advertising, and pricing strategies.
items.group: Risks Related to Brand Relevance and Brand Execution

items.heading: We may not be successful in implementing important strategic initiatives (including our restructuring plans), effectively managing growth, or executing strategic transactions, any of which may have an adverse impact on our business and financial results.
Evolving consumer preferences and tastes, as well as adverse public or medical opinions about the health effects of consuming our products, may adversely affect our business.
If our business partners and third-party providers do not satisfactorily fulfill their responsibilities and commitments, it could damage our brand, and our financial results could suffer.
Reported incidents involving food- or beverage-borne illnesses, tampering, adulteration, contamination, or mislabeling, whether or not accurate, could harm our business.
